name: Tactical RMM
summary: Tactical RMM is source-available software you host yourself. Its license grants use free of charge, including for monitoring in-house and customer networks. Offering it as a commercial or SaaS service needs AmidaWare's prior written approval. A Golang agent runs scripts in several languages, patches Windows and sends alerts.

facts.text: Remote execution covers bash, batch, PowerShell, Python, nushell and deno scripts, with a scheduled task runner.
Automated checks cover CPU, disk, memory, services, scripts and event logs, with email, SMS and webhook alerts.
Windows, Linux and Mac agents are supported, but the Mac and Linux agents and code-signed Windows agents are listed as sponsorship features.
The license requires AmidaWare's prior written approval for all commercial or for-profit service use and bars offering it as part of a SaaS product without permission.

plans.name: Self-hosted
plans.notes: License grant is free of charge. You pay for your own server, and sponsorship unlocks some agent features

hiddenCosts: You run and secure the server yourself.
Sponsorship tiers carry the Mac and Linux agents and code-signed Windows agents; the docs give no sponsorship price.
Commercial service use needs written approval, and the license lists no fee for it.
